params.message:
R P3-1.1 says how a partner gets a token: from the user screen, renewed through api/token

The rule promised a token on a user's password through POST api/token, a grant that has been
off since Passport 12. Partners use the personal access token from the user screen. The route
stays because Passport renews a token there with a refresh token; the password grant stays off.
Recorded as a decision; finding api-token-wachtwoordgrant-uit solved.
